excluded: Pilot/smoke trials, imported baseline studies, incomplete studies, and rows explicitly marked analysis_included=false. One superseded MBPP+ Muse evaluation row excluded.
tokens: Original per-trial charged tokens or retained debit; unknown all-attempt expenditure is not imputed.
stage_calls: Only retained phase records, available in seven later studies; blank for four programming studies.
availability: The public reproducibility-v1 snapshot contains peer-review essentials for saved-outcome analysis of the eleven complementary studies: normalized trials, cell summaries, verifier, concise methods/data notes, provenance hashes, and current paper PDF. Full archives and historical reports are retained locally. It does not include the controlled-study records or claim complete inference replay or independent replication.

publication.scope: Concise peer-review materials; full source/run archives, historical reports, and raw provider payloads are not included.

source_path_convention: Source-file paths identify original workspace inputs, not files promised in this public snapshot. Their hashes record provenance; SHA256SUMS covers the distributed files.

additional_source_document.scope: Generator seed, BBEH and PlanBench dataset revisions and excerpt limits, and task-paired inference details for the eleven complementary studies.
